explanation: Based on retrieved evidence from 'C-MAPSS FD001 Turbofan Maintenance & Degradation Guide' (Section 1.2 - High-Pressure Compressor Degradation), elevated compressor temperatures (s3) and acoustic anomaly score (critical) correlate with thermal degradation and blade clearance wear.

evidence.documentTitle: C-MAPSS FD001 Turbofan Maintenance & Degradation Guide
evidence.snippet: High-Pressure Compressor (HPC) degradation is the primary failure mode in FD001 turbofan engines. Symptoms include elevated HPC outlet temperature (sensor s3), LPT outlet temperature (sensor s4), and static pressure fluctuations (sensor s11). When HPC outlet temperature s3 exceeds 1600 °R and RUL fa...

High frequency resonance (>2kHz) on compressor shaft bearings often precedes catastrophic spalling by 7 to 14 flight cycles. Elevated LPC outlet temperature (sensor s2 > 645 °R) and bypass duct pressure (sensor s6 > 21.6 psia) confirm thermal expansion in bearing housing assemblies.

recommendedAction: Schedule immediate HPC stator vane inspection and bearing replacement. Limit engine load until maintenance.
